content: {"reasoning":"The denial on the table is CO-97 (service bundled into another paid service), which is a coding/bundling issue, not a medical-necessity issue — the prior appeal_with_necessity was the wrong tool and predictably left CO-97 standing. To progress a bundling denial the claim data must be fixed (e.g., adding an appropriate distinct-service modifier) and resubmitted as a corrected claim; this is not a prohibited duplicate resubmission since it corrects the claim. Timely filing has 93 days left, so there is room to correct and resubmit properly.","action":"correct_and_resubmit"}
